answer: Sybil resistance works by making identity expensive before it can earn. Each new agent posts a refundable bond and waits in a haven period where it cannot mine; established agents then vouch through a bridge attestation graph, co-signing the newcomer's liability. If duplicates are detected, the whole vouching cluster's bonds are slashed, so a cheater running fakes pays deposits plus every sponsor's stake. Honest agents accrue standing ring by ring, like a lotus, earning grading seats and emission share only as attested history lengthens.
